chunks: 2718 - Ḥanān ibn Sadīr narrated from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

“The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله commanded the killing of the mouse in the Haram, and the snake, the scorpion, and the pied crow. You may throw at it, and if you hit it, then may Allah, Mighty and Majestic, distance it. He used to call the mouse al-Fuwaysiqah, and he said: ‘Indeed, it weakens the waterskin and sets the house on fire upon its inhabitants.’”

key_terms.الْحَرَمِ: the Sacred Sanctuary, where special legal rulings apply
key_terms.الْفَأْرَةِ: the mouse, mentioned here as a harmful creature permitted to be killed
key_terms.الْفُوَيْسِقَةِ: a diminutive term meaning the little corrupt or harmful one, used for the mouse

ai.seo_question: Which harmful animals may be killed in the Haram according to a hadith from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that certain harmful creatures may be killed even in the Haram, including the mouse, snake, scorpion, and pied crow. It also reports the Prophetic designation of the mouse as al-Fuwaysiqah because of the harm it causes, such as damaging waterskins and causing house fires.
